# b1_media_player

Plays the video of the current record of the data source it is bound to.

## Data binding
Target of a **Data** link from a data source. The player follows the cursor record: **srcField** names the field holding the media URL (default `videoUrl`), **captionsField** the field holding the captions file URL (default `srtUrl`), offered as a download next to the player. A record without a source renders the reason instead of an empty player.

## Working with a timeline
A `b1_demo_timeline` on the same screen names the player's instance in its `playerObject` attribute; it then shows the playhead and seeks the player when a scene is clicked.

## Create with
Instantiate the shared master `DemoFactoryRunPlayer` (run rows: videoUrl / srtUrl) inside a panel or tab and link the run data source to it.
label: Media Player
objectTypeDescription: A video player bound to a record: plays the media the record's source field points at and offers its captions file. Project-owned type of the Demo Factory Studio (b1-demo-studio, issue #17); a b1_demo_timeline on the same screen can follow and seek it.
